summary: AIFU Inc., a Shenzhen-based NYSE-listed foreign private issuer filing a 6-K (US equivalent of a Form 8-K current report), completed a previously announced issuance of 10,000,000 Class B ordinary shares to Expansion Group Ltd. under a September 9, 2026 share subscription agreement, at US$0.002 per share for US$20,000 gross proceeds earmarked for general working capital. Post-issuance, 16,175,748 ordinary shares are outstanding (5,925,748 Class A; 10,250,000 Class B), with Expansion holding roughly 63.37% of shares and 99.43% of voting power. Watch control concentration, potential squeeze-out or take-private follow-on, and minority governance risk.
